svg.title: mh@wasikarn core workflow: install, activate, gate, verify
svg.desc: A left-to-right flow with three zones — install, runtime hooks, and verify. A plugin manifest activates through a working-tree cache into a session. PreToolUse gates fan out in parallel and merge deny-over-allow into a single decision. Compliance audits run on fresh context and feed a maker-verifier loop.

g.text: a number the gate can branch on
never a vibe the model rationalizes
a verifier must be a fresh context
